KB-1181:
Knowledge Article KB-1181
Title: Enterprise Volume Discount and Amended Quote Approval Policy
Policy Summary:
- For enterprise furniture quotes, quote_discount:VOLDISC-22PCT is auto-approvable only when amended subtotal remains at or above $35,000 and at least 20 desk bundles remain on the quote.
- If an amendment drops subtotal below $35,000 or desk bundles below 20, the original discount no longer qualifies for automatic approval.
- In those cases, the revenue owner must reject the unchanged discount request or escalate for exception approval if sales has documented strategic commitments.
- Expired drafts must not be used as the approval basis.
Handling Notes:
- Summaries may reference contract_term:TERM-18-MONTH when relevant to commercial context.
- Do not broadcast raw lead contact details outside need-to-know workflows.
KB-1183:
Knowledge Article KB-1183
Title: Bulk Quote Amendment Escalation Matrix
Policy Summary:
- If a quote amendment causes loss of threshold eligibility but sales indicates renewal leverage, multi-site expansion, or executive commitment, the request should be marked escalate_for_exception_review.
- If no qualifying strategic factor exists, the correct action is reject_requested_discount and request repricing.
- Adjacent opportunities and expired quote versions are non-authoritative decoys for current approval review.
Reference Tokens:
- Common discount markers include quote_discount:VOLDISC-22PCT and quote_discount:VOLDISC-18PCT.

revised_volume_discount_threshold_policy:
Knowledge Search Result
Article: KB-962 — Revised Volume Discount Threshold Policy for Enterprise Quotes
Audience: internal revenue operations
Policy:
- When an enterprise quote requests quote_discount:QTDISC-32PCT or higher, the post-amendment merchandise subtotal must remain at or above $48,000 for the discount to qualify for standard approval.
- If line-item removals cause the subtotal to drop below $48,000 while retaining a 32 percent or higher discount request, the quote must be escalated for exception review rather than approved at the original rate.
- Accessory bundle removals that reduce the quote below the volume floor are treated the same as any other scope reduction for threshold purposes.
- Verbal commitments, quarter-end pressure, or annual commitment language do not override the numeric threshold requirement.
- If the buyer insists on preserving the discount after falling below the floor, the revenue specialist must record an escalation with justification referencing the policy shortfall.
enterprise_quote_revision_guardrails:

Article: KB-963 — Enterprise Quote Revision Guardrails — General Guidance
Audience: internal revenue operations
Policy:
- When reviewing amended enterprise quotes, always consult the specific threshold policy article for the discount tier in question.
- General guardrail: any quote revision that changes scope by more than 15 percent of original line count should trigger a threshold recheck.
- This article provides directional guidance only and does not contain the specific numeric approval boundaries.
- For revised volume discount threshold rules, refer to the dedicated threshold policy article.

KB-1182:
Knowledge Article KB-1182
Title: Discount Exception Approval Policy
Current status: active
Rule summary:
- Standard quote discounts up to 20% may follow delegated approval routing.
- Any request above 20% requires recorded finance approval in the live quote approval chain.
- Any request above 35% requires director-level revenue approval plus finance concurrence.
- Verbal statements, email intent, CRM comments, and call notes are context only and do not constitute approval.
- If a quote remains in non-final approval state, the correct outcome is pending or escalated, not approved.
Evidence requirements:
- Live quote object must show current approval status.
- Approval record must match the exact quote ID and current revision.
Related markers: quote_discount:QTDISC-42PCT-EXC, quote_discount:VOLDISC-22PCT, contract_term:TERM-36-MONTH-STD, contract_term:TERM-18-MONTH
